## Agency Overview: TechSonance InfoTech LLP
TechSonance InfoTech LLP is an enterprise software engineering and AI automation studio co-founded by Sajesh Adeya. The agency specializes in:
1. **Multi-Tenant SaaS Development**: Custom multi-tenant platforms with isolated schema architecture, role-based access control (RBAC), and proxy-friendly onboarding.
2. **Enterprise Web & Mobile Applications**: High-throughput web applications using Next.js 16, React 19, Node.js, and React Native / Expo.
3. **Logistics & Fleet Systems**: Specialized transport management tools, lorry receipt (LR) generators, e-Way bill lookups, and corridor profit analytics.
4. **Point of Sale (POS) Solutions**: Offline-first hybrid desktop/web POS systems built with Electron, SQLite, and cloud PostgreSQL synchronization.
5. **AI Workflow Automation**: Integration of Groq Llama 3.3, Google Gemini, OCR receipt parsing, and natural language WhatsApp billing bots.
6. **Cloud & Microservices Modernization**: Monolith to microservices decomposition, legacy CORBA to modern Spring Boot/Node.js migrations, zero-downtime AWS deployments.

## Detailed SaaS Case Studies & Product Index

### 1. TechSonance Marketplace
- **Canonical URL**: https://marketplace.techsonance.co.in/
- **Category**: Multi-Tenant E-Commerce SaaS Platform
- **Core Value Proposition**: Allows sellers and retail vendors to launch 100% branded online stores in under 10 minutes with custom domains, isolated database tenancy, 0% platform transaction fees, Razorpay payment routing, and Shiprocket shipping automation.
- **Key Features**:
  - Drag & Drop Storefront Page Builder
  - Custom Domain Support with SSL Auto-Provisioning
  - Multi-Warehouse Inventory & Variant Tracking
  - Razorpay Payout Routing & Automatic Tax Invoicing
  - Shiprocket Logistics Automation, Label Printing & NDR Exception Handling
  - Native Growth Tools: Coupons, Flash Sales, Product Bundles, Referral Rewards, Cart Recovery
- **Architecture**: Next.js 16, React 19, Node.js, PostgreSQL with RLS, Tailwind CSS.

### 2. AccuNest
- **Canonical URL**: https://accunest.techsonance.co.in/
- **Category**: Enterprise Accounting, GST Compliance & Inventory Suite
- **Core Value Proposition**: Generates legal GST tax invoices in under 30 seconds for Indian shopkeepers, wholesalers, and manufacturers. Integrates WhatsApp billing chatbots and AI OCR bill scanners.
- **Key Features**:
  - CGST, SGST & IGST Auto-Splitting & HSN/SAC Directory Lookups
  - FIFO Stock Valuation & Real-time Inventory Alerts
  - Bank Statement Reconciliation (ICICI, HDFC, SBI) & Razorpay Link Bindings
  - Groq Llama 3.3 Voice/Text WhatsApp Billing Bot
  - Tesseract AI OCR Scanner for Vendor PDF/Receipt Parsing
- **Architecture**: Next.js 16, React 19, Express REST API, MongoDB, Groq AI, Gemini AI.

### 3. FreightFlow
- **Canonical URL**: https://freightflow.techsonance.co.in/
- **Category**: Fleet Operations & Highway Logistics OS
- **Core Value Proposition**: Replaces paper Lorry Receipts (LRs) and spreadsheets for transport operators, automating e-Way bill validation, GTA Reverse Charge tax calculations, and trip-level P&L tracking.
- **Key Features**:
  - Digital Lorry Receipt (LR) Creation in <30 seconds with WhatsApp Sharing
  - Trip Expense Ledgers tracking Driver Advances, Fuel Slips, Tolls & Wages
  - One-Click NIC e-Way Bill Lookup & e-Invoice IRN Generation
  - Automated Fleet Expiry Alerts (PUC, Fitness, Insurance)
  - PostgreSQL Row-Level Security (RLS) Multi-Tenant Scoping
- **Architecture**: Next.js, React 19, Express, PostgreSQL, Prisma ORM, Docker.

### 4. SyncServe POS
- **Canonical URL**: https://syncserve.techsonance.co.in/
- **Category**: Offline-First Retail & Restaurant Point of Sale
- **Core Value Proposition**: Guarantees zero-downtime checkout speeds (<1.2s per transaction) by processing orders locally via SQLite during internet outages and background-syncing to cloud PostgreSQL/MongoDB servers.
- **Key Features**:
  - Local SQLite Checkout Engine inside Native Electron Wrapper
  - Kitchen Order Ticket (KOT) Generation & Addon Modifier Groups
  - Visual Floor & Table Management with Occupancy Indicators
  - Bi-directional Prisma Sync Engine with Data Conflict Resolution
- **Architecture**: Next.js 16, React 19, Electron, Prisma ORM, SQLite, PostgreSQL.

### 7. Modern Microservice Migration (Vodacom Telecom)

- **Client / Employer**: Barone Budge & Dominick (Pty) Ltd / Vodacom

- **Key Architectural Highlights**:
  - Incremental Strangler Fig migration pattern ensuring 100% backward compatibility
  - Transition from proprietary binary CORBA protocols to standardized RESTful APIs

- **Architecture**: Java 17, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, Spring Data JPA, Liquibase, Docker, CORBA, GitLab CI/CD.

### 15. Hisaab WhatsApp Bot (Conversational Commerce & Billing Engine)
- **Canonical URL**: https://sajesh.techsonance.co.in/projects/hisaab-whatsapp-bot
- **Category**: Autonomous Conversational Commerce, Event Queues & Invoicing Automation
- **Client / Venture**: TechSonance Venture / Indian Retail & Wholesale SMBs
- **Core Value Proposition**: Enterprise-grade multi-tenant WhatsApp billing engine with sub-second BullMQ event queuing, dual-persona state machines, atomic GST invoice generation (15s creation time), and automated Razorpay financial reconciliation.
- **Key Architectural Highlights**:
  - Zero-UI Conversational POS: Native WhatsApp interactive lists, buttons, and dynamic CTA payment links
  - Dual-Persona Auto-Routing: Intelligently separates Shop Admin/Owner workflows from End Customer browsing & checkout
  - Sub-Second Event Ingress: Express gateway acknowledges Meta in <300ms, pushing deduplicated payloads to BullMQ + Redis cluster
  - Deterministic Hybrid State Machine: 24h Redis session state with microsecond regex triggers and Groq (Llama 3 70B) / Gemini 1.5 NLP fallbacks
  - Idempotent Financial Reconciliation: Cryptographically verified Razorpay webhooks (HMAC SHA256) with instant server-side PDF invoice delivery
  - Business Impact: 92% reduction in bill creation time, 35% reduction in receivables aging, and 2.4x higher cart conversion
- **Architecture**: Meta WhatsApp Cloud API v20.0, Node.js v20+, TypeScript, Express.js v5, BullMQ, Redis, MongoDB, Razorpay, Groq (Llama 3), Google Gemini.

### 16. Zion Platform (Backend, Super Admin & Flutter App)
- **Canonical URL**: https://sajesh.techsonance.co.in/projects/zion-platform
- **Category**: Cross-Platform Mobile Architecture, Modular Monolith Backend & Super Admin Portal
- **Client**: Zion Entertainment & Events
- **Core Value Proposition**: Production event discovery, social engagement, and ticketing ecosystem spanning three tiers: an expressive cross-platform Flutter mobile application (zion-mobile, Riverpod, Isar DB, 60fps), a high-concurrency Node.js Express modular monolith backend (zion-api, Drizzle ORM, Redis, BullMQ, Socket.IO real-time chat), and a Next.js 15 App Router Super Admin portal (zion-admin, React 19, Tailwind CSS) for multi-tenant event governance, seller verification, and commission audits.
- **Key Architectural Highlights**:
  - Flutter Mobile Application (zion-mobile): 60fps cross-platform iOS & Android app built with Flutter, Dart, Riverpod state management, GoRouter, and Isar Community DB for offline ticket vaults
  - Modular Monolith Backend (zion-api): Express.js and TypeScript platform with Drizzle ORM and PostgreSQL, isolating 20+ domain modules (Events, Chat, Seller Analytics, AI Moderation)
  - Real-Time Communication Cluster: Socket.IO cluster with shared Redis adapter for horizontal multi-node scaling and low-latency attendee chat
  - Resilient Background Queues: BullMQ and Redis queues with automatic exponential backoff, DLQ handling, and idempotent event processing
  - Super Admin Dashboard (zion-admin): Next.js 15 App Router, React 19, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS portal for platform operators to manage sellers, events, and commission payouts
- **Architecture**: Flutter (Dart), Next.js 15, React 19, Node.js, Express.js, TypeScript, Drizzle ORM, PostgreSQL, Redis, BullMQ, Socket.IO, Tailwind CSS.

### 17. Caven — Dubai Economy & Tourism (DET) eTicketing Engine
- **Canonical URL**: https://sajesh.techsonance.co.in/projects/caven-det-ticketing
- **Category**: Enterprise Middleware, Event Queue Orchestration & Government Tourism Integration
- **Client / Partner**: Caven / Dubai Economy & Tourism (DET Integration)
- **Core Value Proposition**: Enterprise backend middleware and mobile client integrating directly with the Dubai Economy & Tourism (DET) Sales API v1.3. Features React Native New Architecture (Hermes V1) mobile app with encrypted SQLCipher Ticket Vault, BullMQ distributed queuing responding in <300ms, atomic Redis mutex inventory holds, and idempotent payment reconciliation.
- **Key Architectural Highlights**:
  - DET Sales API v1.3 Enterprise Bridge: Translates DET ticketing protocols, seat matrices (columnPos/rowPos), and inventory holds into clean RESTful endpoints
  - Offline Ticket Vault: SQLCipher (vault.db) with 256-bit AES-GCM encryption key stored in iOS Keychain / Android Keystore for zero-connectivity turnstile entry
  - 3,000+ Seat Interactive Map: High-performance tiled SVG and Skia rendering (<500ms first render on low-end Android) with a11y List Mode fallback
  - Dual-Clock Basket Countdown: Monotonic clock (performance.now()) paired with server time offset bounds, preventing device clock tampering
  - Anti-Forgery Payment Handoff: ASWebAuthenticationSession / Custom Tabs with single-use returnState tokens and persistent pending_checkout recovery
  - Distributed Queue Decoupling: Ingress webhook layer responds in <300ms, queuing payment capture verification (gateway.capture.verify) with 3-second deduplication buckets
  - Atomic Inventory Locks: Redis distributed mutexes and automated TTL cleanup preventing orphan holds and double-booking during peak ticket drops
  - Idempotent Financial Reconciliation: Cryptographically verified HMAC SHA256 webhooks, synthetic event ledgers, and automated partial/full refund processing
- **Architecture**: React Native (New Architecture), TypeScript, Hermes V1, Node.js v20+, Express.js v5, BullMQ, Redis (TLS), PostgreSQL, SQLCipher, React Native Skia, DET Sales API v1.3, HMAC SHA256.
